title: Raku Workshop
evidence_sentence: A raku workshop is coming in Winter 2026/27 for potters with bisqued pieces.
summary: Raku workshop (Winter 2026/27) where you bring 2–3 bisqued pieces, wear natural fiber clothing and closed-toed shoes, and fire outdoors. Requires willingness to experiment. $75/person. Registration coming soon.
bring: 2–3 bisqued pieces (not intended for food use); natural fiber clothing; closed-toed shoes; outdoor clothes; water and snacks
